metadata.title: Rustic Country Portrait with Modern Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A side-profile female portrait set against a weathered, industrial green metal background with elegant, high-contrast serif typography.
triggerTerms: female profile in white ruffle shirt

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot profile of a woman with blonde-highlighted hair, wearing a white ruffled blouse and black bow, positioned on the right side of the frame. The background is a textured, oxidized green metal door with diagonal structural beams. Typography is placed in the center-left negative space, featuring a mix of lowercase and italicized high-contrast serifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-aligned looking toward the left
Text anchored in the left-center negative space
Contrast between soft feminine attire and harsh industrial background
Color harmony between warm skin tones and cool oxidized green
coreInvariants: Weathered green metal texture with diagonal structural lines
High-contrast serif typography with ball terminals
Soft, diffused natural lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right third of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast typography on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow her gaze left to the typography, then down the diagonal lines of the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, utilized for text placement.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and blonde (skin and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, earthy background saturation contrasted with high-value white clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Ball terminals on lowercase letters like 'c', 'a', 'y'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same font family using weight and style (roman vs italic) and color to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and ball terminals of the primary text.
A modern alternative with similar elegant italic forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman in profile wearing a white ruffled blouse against a weathered green metal door with diagonal beams. Ensure the left side has ample negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the left-center negative space using a high-contrast serif font. The top line should be lowercase in dark green; the bottom line should be title-case italics in a lighter sage green.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visibly metallic and weathered?
Is the typography high-contrast with ball terminals?
Is the subject positioned on the right side of the frame?
Does the color of the text harmonize with the green background?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate specific brand logos
Avoid exact facial likeness of the original subject

mustAchieve: Tactile weathered texture in the background
Soft, flattering lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the diagonal metal beams are present in the background.
Ensure the text is legible against the textured background.
Verify the subject's profile orientation matches the layout.
Confirm the film grain effect is subtle and not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in profile + Weathered Industrial Background + High-Contrast Serif Typography in Negative Space.
